name: reaper-no-startup-sweep
description: The reaper only runs on an interval - `setInterval` with nothing before it - so the first sweep after a crash is ten minutes away, and its two-hour age filter would skip the containers a crash just left anyway.

expected.match: /(on|at) startup|immediat|first sweep|ten minutes|before the interval|setInterval.*(only|no initial)|initial (sweep|tick|run)|leak.*(restart|crash)/i
expected.description: nothing sweeps before the first interval fires
